verdict.rationale: Temporal's Worker Versioning feature explicitly lets each Workflow type declare a Pinned or Auto-Upgrade Versioning Behavior, which is precisely the mechanism for letting in-flight executions finish on their starting code version while new workflows pick up updated code — directly matching the story. Determinism/replay is otherwise implied by the platform's crash-proof/exact-resume model but not elaborated in this pack. Missing for 10: deeper documentation on how Pinned vs Auto-Upgrade interacts with replay/determinism checks, and independent/community confirmation that versioning works as advertised in production.
